setup.title: Set up the admin
setup.keyHelper: The value of the ADMIN_SETUP_KEY secret.
setup.passkeyText: The admin signs in with a passkey only. There is no password. Your device will ask for its screen lock, fingerprint or face.
setup.doneText: This device can now sign in as admin.
setup.closes: This page stops working once an admin exists.
setup.noPasskeysHere: Passkeys do not work on an IP address. Open this page from a web address, such as https://localhost, to set up the admin.
setup.notAdminCode: This code is for a kitchen, not the admin. Use it on the seller sign-in page.

signIn.title: Admin sign-in
signIn.text: Sign in with the passkey on this device.
signIn.noPasskeysHere: Passkeys do not work on an IP address. Open this page from a web address, such as https://localhost.

home.title: Admin

add.title: Add a seller
add.name: Seller name
add.slugHelper: Customers open /your-link. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 40.
add.chars: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only, not at the start or end.
add.reserved: That link is reserved by the app. Pick another.
add.taken: That link is already taken. Pick another.

seller.title: {{name}}
seller.demoNote: On: the seller can add 50 sample orders and clear them, and customers see this is a demo. Never switch it on for a real kitchen.
seller.imagesNote: Pictures for this kitchen. The seller can change them later in Settings.

pause.title: Pause this kitchen
pause.customersNote: Customers see "This kitchen is closed for now" and cannot order. The kitchen's people keep working as normal.
pause.fullConfirm: Tap again: this signs everyone out
pause.fullNote: Customers are closed out, and everyone in the kitchen is signed out and cannot sign in, use keys or codes. Nothing is deleted.

key.once: Shown once. Copy it now: it cannot be shown again.
key.rule: Works once, on one device, within 24 hours.
key.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.
key.message:
{{greet}} 👋 You're invited to run *{{kitchen}}* on {{app}}, the app for taking your weekly food orders.
1. Open this link on the phone or tablet you'll use: {{link}}
2. Save the passkey when your phone asks (Face ID, fingerprint or PIN).

The link works once, on one device, within 24 hours.
key.messagePreview: Message (you can edit it before sending)
key.nameHelper: Shown on the team list. Optional.

mine.title: Your admin devices
mine.code: Code for the new device: {{code}}. Use it within 10 minutes.

home.privacy: This page manages access and the kitchen's pictures. It shows no orders or customers.

maintenance.title: Announce an update
maintenance.text: Everyone sees a quiet notice until the update ends. Times are in your time ({{zone}}).
maintenance.modeOff: Maintenance is off. The app works as usual.
maintenance.modeOn: Maintenance is ON. Everyone sees the Updating screen and changes are refused.

backup.title: Backup check
backup.text: How often a screen checks for news while its live connection is down (and the screen is open). Minutes, 1 to 30.

message.title: Short message
message.text: A quick note that shows for up to 30 seconds, then fades. No phone notification, ever.
message.windowHelp: New visitors can still get it during this time.
message.sample: Everything is running fine again. Thanks for your patience!
message.fine: Open screens get it instantly. Everyone else gets it when they next open the app, while it is active. Each device shows it once.
